sticker_path.label: Sticker image
sticker_path.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or animated GIF shown over the screen. Bring your own file.

sticker_dir.label: Sticker folder
sticker_dir.description: Folder with PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or animated GIF files. If set, one is picked on each trigger instead of the single sticker image.

sticker_selection.label: Sticker selection
sticker_selection.description: How the next sticker is chosen from the folder.

sticker_position.label: Sticker position
sticker_position.description: Where the sticker appears on screen. Auto keeps it centered.

sound_path.label: Sound
sound_path.description: Sound played when the sticker appears.

size_px.label: Sticker size (px)
size_px.description: Sticker box, in logical pixels. The image always fits inside this square.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.description: Maximum sticker opacity, before the fade-out.

hold_ms.label: Hold time (ms)
hold_ms.description: How long a static sticker stays on screen.

extra_ms.label: Extra time after GIF (ms)
extra_ms.description: Keep the sticker visible this long after an animated GIF has finished.
